body.prompt: Keep everything in the first image exactly the same: same scene, composition, characters, lighting and miniature style. Only replace every chocolate cake or snack in the scene with the snack from the second image: Korean Choco Pie style snack: a flat round sandwich cake about the size of a palm and about 2.5 cm thick, perfectly smooth glossy milk-chocolate coating with a soft dome top, when cut or bitten it shows two soft light-brown sponge cake layers with a thin white marshmallow layer in the middle. the children share one, broken into pieces so the white marshmallow layer shows. No text, no logos.
